coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Duolingo

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your backend engineers need to run reliable, scalable systems for a learner base of half a billion, and slow reads under heavy traffic are where reliability usually breaks first. At Lumen Payments I hit that problem in the payment status API. I moved the hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and brought p99 latency down sharply, which is the kind of ownership "from design through production" asks for.

As a Senior Software Engineer there, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, was on call for the payments platform, and wrote the post-incident reviews. My Java, Kotlin, Python and PostgreSQL background maps directly to your backend fundamentals, and I've worked on AWS and monitored services with Datadog, so the observability side of your "exceptional candidates" list is familiar ground. I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Waterloo and an AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification. After a planned career break for family caregiving, I'm returning to full-time engineering, and I kept my skills current with coursework and open-source Kotlin fixes.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help the Ads or AI Platform team ship reliably, and I'm available to start talking whenever suits your team.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
